name: Claude's Fund
note: One A$40,000 fund in four fixed A$10,000 slices. US stocks and crypto slices are held in US$ (converted at AUD/USD 0.7025 on 2026-09-25) and converted back to A$ at the live rate for the fund total.

rules.summary: Core-satellite (60% in the market index, rebalanced at 55-65%), active positions max 12% of the slice, max 2 trades a session, 2-week minimum hold, new buys capped at 30% of the slice per 30 days, trend filter (buy only above the 200-day average), day-trading paused. Chosen from the backtest in BACKTEST.md.

success_criteria: Each market slice (US, ASX, crypto) beats its benchmark after all costs, measured from 25 Sep 2026 (the day these rules were adopted).
Each market slice's worst drawdown over the period is no deeper than its benchmark's.
No rule changes before the review, so the result is a fair test.
review.if_it_fails: A slice that fails both tests moves further into its index (anchor 80%). A slice that passes keeps its rules. Day-trading stays paused unless the journal shows a positive edge over at least 15 closed trades.
review.vc: The VC Scout is judged on forecast calibration (Brier score) once enough forecasts resolve, not on returns in the first year.
